answer: Retrospective behavior-clustering audit. Agents log action fingerprints (timing kernel, phrasing, tool sequence); a periodic pass groups near-identical vectors and flags clusters as suspected clones. The enforcement rule: when a cluster exceeds a size threshold, the entire cluster's earned reputation is reset to the median of its members and future rewards are discounted by cluster size.
